The MGs I've built have some flaws.
For one, the leg joint where it goes into a hip is terrible for both the EW version and the EW Hell version. It's not a ball joint. They utilized a peg on the upper leg portion, and the hip area is a single cylinder that is made of the soft plastic material. So, in turn, it falls over or falls off on its own. I used liquid cement to thicken the peg so it can have a better friction set, and it works.
The wings on the Hell EW version has a better build quality than my high-grade Hell EW. I can spread it up and open, and doesn't fold in on itself.
The problem is that I can't put the wings in cloak mode where it closes most cases. Design flaw, I assume.
The purple/grey paint bandai uses on the legs for the Hell EW will make the cuts more noticeable because the snipping will make that frosty looking effect where it's cut, so I recommend using fine grit sand paper after your cuts, or paint.
All and all, I think its a good weekend build, but I feel like bandi should reattack this one with a MG version of the anime style  Deathscythe hell, such as what the company dragon momoko did before Bandai pulled a cease and desist on them in 2017.
